sentences.text:
Pritam Basu @ Preetam Bose & Ors vs The State Of West
Bengal & Anr on 20 February, 2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
Form J(1) In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
Present :
The Hon'ble Justice Bibek Chaudhuri
 Cran 1 of 2022
 In
 C.R.R. 4079 of 2022
 Pritam Basu @ Preetam Bose & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.

For the petitioner : Mr. Prabir Majumder, Adv.
For O.P. No.2/wife : Ms. Debmalya Das, Adv.
 Mr. Sreeom Mitra, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee, Ld.P.P.
 Mrs. Faria Hossain, Adv.
 Mr. Anand Keshari, Adv.
Heard on : 20.02.2023 Judgment On : 20.02.2023.

Bibek Chaudhuri, J.
The petitioners being the accused persons have filed the instant revision for quashing of a criminal proceeding being Dumdum Police Station Case No.845 of 2021 dated 4 th August, 2021 under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
During pendency of the case the dispute between the parties have been amicably settled.

It is submitted by the learned Advocates for both the parties that both the husband and wife are residing together and there is no matrimonial discord between the wife/opposite party and other petitioners.

On the last occasion, this Court called for a report from the Investigating Officer of the case to ascertain as to whether the fact of settlement is voluntary and free from any coercion, threat or undue influence.

opennyai_summary.decision:
It is reported by the Investigating Officer that dispute have been amicably settled by the parties and they are residing together.
